saw_lines: Wine buyers rarely choose on label alone. They pick by occasion or a trusted recommendation, then come back to producers they know.
So a new buyer decides in one line whether a bottle is worth a click, and no Meta ad makes the case.
Your 2 Google text ads are the only copy we can see, and 0 live Meta ads means no hook is tested yet. Launch three Meta ads around Wein der Woche.
ads_1: Wein der Woche and auction wine stories as Meta hooks, tested against a gift angle
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
